description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of various models with different perturbation setups and compares them to unperturbed trained model variants. The horizontal axis contains 14 categories representing different models and perturbation setups, labeled as "embedding", "1st layer", "random layers", "random layers +B2", "random layers +L2", "random layers +R2", "random layers +permute", "random", "random +B2", "random +L2", "random +R2", "random +permute", and "unperturbed". The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 70 to 95, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a category and containing two bars of different shades, except for the last category "unperturbed", which has two orange bars. The blue bars represent the accuracy of the embedding and first layers' probes, with values of approximately 80 and 81, respectively. The green bars represent random models with pre-trained embedding layers, with the lighter shade having values ranging from around 79 to 80, and the darker shade having values around 81-82. The red bars represent random models with random embedding layers, with the lighter shade having values around 72-73, and the darker shade having values around 74. The orange bars for the "unperturbed" category have values of approximately 90 and 91. The bars within each group are not sorted, but the categories are arranged in a specific order, with the blue bars first, followed by the green bars, then the red bars, and finally the orange bars.
